## Profile

I am a master's student in **Management and Digital Technology at the Technical University of Munich, Campus Heilbronn**.

Before beginning my master's degree, I built a strong professional foundation in financial controlling, business analysis, budgeting, compliance, and management reporting. I am currently expanding this experience through supply-chain strategy and data analytics work at Mercedes-Benz Group AG.

My main strength is the ability to connect business questions with analytical tools. I enjoy structuring complex information, identifying performance drivers, and turning data into clear recommendations for decision-makers.

## Working Style

I work in a structured and business-oriented way. I place particular emphasis on:

- understanding the business purpose behind an analysis;
- ensuring data quality before drawing conclusions;
- communicating findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders;
- building reusable and transparent analytical workflows;
- balancing technical feasibility with practical business value.
